 Michael Bublé Joins The Great Gonzo to Promote Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring the Muppets: Obligatory Holiday Overlay
 Lauren Stracner 
 Published: November 16, 2026 
 Michael Bublé Joins The Great Gonzo to Promote Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring the Muppets: Obligatory Holiday Overlay
 Michael Bublé teamed up with The Great Gonzo to celebrate the Obligatory Holiday Overlay of Rock ‘n’ Roller Coaster Starring the Muppets at Walt Disney World.
 Michael Bublé & The Great Gonzo
 In the video shared by Disney Parks , purportedly shot behind the scenes of his recording, Michael Bublé says he’s in the studio to record a special new song for Rock ‘n’ Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets at Disney’s Hollywood Studios.
 Gonzo reminds him that it’s actually a song for the ✨holiday overlay✨, noting, “It’s an important key distinction!” Gonzo, of course, has some ideas for a literal publicity stunt for Michael that involve a unicycle, a tightrope, an orchestra, and downtown Burbank.
 He even gifts Michael his own bright-red daredevil cape, promising that he’s “gonna love” falling “three stories off a tightrope.”

 And check out our POV videos of the other three songs for the holiday overlay:
 “Holiday Road” – The Electric Mayhem ft. Kermit the Frog and Fozzie Bear
 “Christmas (Baby Please Come Home”) – The Electric Mayhem ft. Jennifer Hudson
 “Silver Bells” – The Electric Mayhem ft. Cyndi Lauper
 Walt Disney Imagineering also shared a behind-the-scenes look at creating the Rock ’n’ Roller Coaster Starring The Muppets: Obligatory Holiday Overlay .
 Have you heard “Little Saint Nick” on Rock ‘n’ Roller Coaster Starring the Muppets this season? Let us know on social media!
